description: This script checks for the presence of Storybook story files for UI components and plugins within the Superset frontend project. It scans specific directories for React component files and story files, and provides a report on missing stories, with optional suggestions for adding them.

methods.name: hasStoriesFile
methods.description: Checks if a given directory contains any Storybook story files with specific filename patterns.

methods.name: hasReactComponents
methods.description: Checks if a directory contains React component files (TSX), excluding test, story, type, and index files.

methods.name: getPluginName
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from its directory path.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Gets the base name of a component directory path.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the coverage check, reports missing stories, and optionally suggests fixes.
